description: Labelled tasks for the capability router. Each task names a hunting intent and the capability class that should govern it. The label is the CAPABILITY CLASS, not a specific file: a router that finds the right capability in the wrong file is still wrong, and a router that finds three files in the right class is not worse than one that finds one.
